# Degraded availability for GPT-5.3 Codex and GPT-5.6 models in Copilot

## What Changed

Nov 10, 00:05 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Nov 9, 23:59 UTC Update - The issue affecting GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.6 Luna, and GPT-5.6 Sol in Copilot products and IDE surfaces has been mitigated. We are monitoring the service to ensure stability. Nov 9, 23:46 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 9, 23:22 UTC Update - Copilot is operating normally. Nov 9, 23:22 UTC Update - Copilot AI Model Providers is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate. Nov 9, 23:16 UTC Update - We are experiencing degraded availability for GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.6 Luna, and GPT-5.6 Sol in Copilot products and IDE surfaces due to an issue with an upstream model provider.
